question: One-third of a journey is covered at a speed of 2 km/hr, the next one-third of the journey is covered at a speed of 87 km/hr and the remaining journey is covered at a speed of 53 km/hr. The average speed (in km/hr, rounded off to 1 decimal place) for the entire journey is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 3 equal parts of a journey, Average Speed = 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx)

Here x = 2, y = 87, z = 53.

xy + yz + zx = (2 × 87) + (87 × 53) + (53 × 2) = 174 + 4611 + 106 = 4891

Average Speed = (3 × 2 × 87 × 53) ÷ 4891 = 27666 ÷ 4891 ≈ 5.656 km/hr

Rounding off to 1 decimal place, we get 5.7 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.7 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speeds for each one-third distance are 2 km/hr, 87 km/hr, and 53 km/hr respectively.

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the total distance be 3d. Thus, each one-third distance is d.

⇒ Total Time = (d ÷ 2) + (d ÷ 87) + (d ÷ 53)

⇒ Total Time = d × [(87 × 53) + (2 × 53) + (2 × 87)] ÷ (2 × 87 × 53)

⇒ Total Time = d × [4611 + 106 + 174] ÷ 9222

⇒ Total Time = d × (4891 ÷ 9222)

⇒ Average Speed = 3d ÷ [d × (4891 ÷ 9222)]

⇒ Average Speed = (3 × 9222) ÷ 4891 = 27666 ÷ 4891

⇒ Average Speed ≈ 5.656 km/hr

⇒ Rounded to 1 decimal place = 5.7 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.7 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

If a journey is divided into two equal halves covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed General Formula

When distances are unequal, strictly use Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Relative Speed

For objects moving in opposite directions: Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. For same direction: |S₁ − S₂|.
